Every engagement starts with the biology — not the assay menu. We follow the cascade your
therapeutic creates and work backwards to the measurement strategy that captures the critical
events.

01

#### Causality, not a checklist

One biological event leads to the next. LNP uptake precedes translation. Translation precedes ADA
formation. ADA formation precedes neutralization. We design measurement programs that follow the
chain — so no signal goes undetected because it wasn’t on the SOW.

02

#### Phase-intelligent from day one

What you need to measure in a rat biodistribution study is different from a Phase 2 patient cohort.
We scope every program with the end phase in mind — so the assay developed preclinically is the same
one your regulator sees in your BLA.

03

#### Regulatory framework matched to your stage

RUO for discovery. Fit-for-purpose for early clinical. GLP, CAP, or CLIA when your program demands
it. We don’t force every study into the same compliance box — we match the framework to where you
are.

04

#### Long-term monitoring builds partnerships

Phase 2 and beyond generate longitudinal samples that require consistent, credible measurement over
years. Our CAP/CLIA infrastructure and biobanking strategy are built for exactly this arc.

## What is Cryonics?

Cryonics is one of the world’s most ambitious scientific experiments – a bold attempt to preserve
human life once current medicine has reached its limits. By preserving the physical structures that
store our memories, personality, and identity, cryonics aims to safeguard each patient until future
medical progress overcomes today’s limitations.

## How it Works

Cryonics begins at the moment of legal passing, once conventional medical science offers no
remaining options. Specialized teams work swiftly to protect and stabilize the patient, slowing the
biological processes that would otherwise lead to rapid deterioration. Through careful cooling and
the introduction of unique cryoprotective solutions, the delicate architecture of life is preserved
in a state of biological stasis. Patients are then cared for indefinitely, until future medical
breakthroughs enable the possibility for restoration and repair.

## Why Alcor?

With over half a century of experience, Alcor stands as the world’s premier cryonics organization.
Our comprehensive approach encompasses advanced preservation technologies, dedicated member
services, elite deployment and recovery teams (DART), and secure long-term care – all backed by
dedicated financial safeguards and world-class research capabilities. Our integrated approach
delivers the most reliable and technologically advanced services available anywhere in the world.

## Cell-Based Therapies Are Not Conventional Drugs. They’re Living Treatments.

Cell therapy programs don’t usually fail because of bad science, they fail because of execution
gaps: [processes][20] that aren’t robust enough to scale, documentation that doesn’t hold up to
regulatory scrutiny, and timelines that slip the moment complexity increases. As a **cell therapy
CDMO**, closing these gaps is our core expertise. We bring the technical depth and manufacturing
rigor needed to keep your program on track from early development through clinical success.

### **Broad Expertise Across Cell Therapy Modalities**

Autologous and allogeneic, engineered (CAR/TCR) and non-engineered — including T-cells, NK cells,
**mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)**, and iPSCs. Whatever your cell type, we’ve likely already solved a
similar challenge.

### **Platform-Agnostic Cell Therapy Manufacturing**

We operate independently of any specific platform or system, allowing us to adapt to your existing
**technologies** and **processes**

### **Built for Regulatory Scrutiny**

We ensure regulatory compliance at every stage, following **ICH Q2 (R1)**, **European
Pharmacopeia**, **EMA/MHRA**, and** US Pharmacopeia **standards, with a proven track record of
**successful audits**.

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

collaborate with.

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

* ### 质粒检测
  
  质粒（英语：Plasmid），是指在细胞的染色体或核区DNA之外，能够自主复制的DNA分子（字源：plasm为生殖质
  ，-id表示粒）。质粒与染色体最主要的区分是，质粒不是细胞生存所必需，染色体则是细胞生存必需的。
  [ 了解更多 ][92]
* ### 慢病毒
  
  慢病毒属（学名：Lentivirus）是逆转录病毒科下的一个属，此属病毒的特征是有较长的时间的潜伏期，例如人
  类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、猴免疫缺陷病毒(SIV)、马传染性贫血(EIA)、
  猫免疫缺陷病毒(FIV)都是慢病毒属，学名中“Lenti-”在拉丁文中有慢的意思。其共同特点为在其基因组的3'和5
  '有高度保守的LTR序列，其R区域用以整合酶的识别。
  [ 了解更多 ][93]

* ### 细胞检测
  
  我们的检测平台设有生物安全二级实验室，致力于提供高标准、高质量的生物质检服务。实验室严格遵循国家认
  证认可监督管理委员会（CMA）、中国合格评定国家认可委员会（CNAS）和良好生产规范（GMP）等质量体系，确
  保检测结果的准确性和可靠性。
  [ 了解更多 ][95]
* ### 外泌体检测
  
  外泌体是指包含了复杂 RNA 和蛋白质的小膜泡
  (30-150nm)，现今，其特指直径在40-100nm的盘状囊泡。1983年，外泌体首次于绵羊网织红细胞中被发现，
  1987年Johnstone将其命名为“exosome”。多种细胞在正常及病理状态下均可分泌外泌体。其主要来源于细胞内溶
  酶体微粒内陷形成的多囊泡体，经多囊泡体外膜与细胞膜融合后释放到胞外基质中 。
  [ 了解更多 ][96]

  质粒（英语：Plasmid），是指在细胞的染色体或核区DNA之外，能够自主复制的DNA分子（字源：plasm为生殖质
  ，-id表示粒）。质粒与染色体最主要的区分是，质粒不是细胞生存所必需，染色体则是细胞生存必需的。

  慢病毒属（学名：Lentivirus）是逆转录病毒科下的一个属，此属病毒的特征是有较长的时间的潜伏期，例如人
  类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、猴免疫缺陷病毒(SIV)、马传染性贫血(EIA)、
  猫免疫缺陷病毒(FIV)都是慢病毒属，学名中“Lenti-”在拉丁文中有慢的意思。其共同特点为在其基因组的3'和5
  '有高度保守的LTR序列，其R区域用以整合酶的识别。

* ### 外泌体检测
  
  外泌体是指包含了复杂 RNA 和蛋白质的小膜泡
  (30-150nm)，现今，其特指直径在40-100nm的盘状囊泡。1983年，外泌体首次于绵羊网织红细胞中被发现，
  1987年Johnstone将其命名为“exosome”。多种细胞在正常及病理状态下均可分泌外泌体。其主要来源于细胞内溶
  酶体微粒内陷形成的多囊泡体，经多囊泡体外膜与细胞膜融合后释放到胞外基质中 。

* ### 质粒检测
  
  质粒（英语：Plasmid），是指在细胞的染色体或核区DNA之外，能够自主复制的DNA分子（字源：plasm为生殖质
  ，-id表示粒）。质粒与染色体最主要的区分是，质粒不是细胞生存所必需，染色体则是细胞生存必需的。
  [ 了解更多 ][92]
* ### 慢病毒
  
  慢病毒属（学名：Lentivirus）是逆转录病毒科下的一个属，此属病毒的特征是有较长的时间的潜伏期，例如人
  类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、猴免疫缺陷病毒(SIV)、马传染性贫血(EIA)、
  猫免疫缺陷病毒(FIV)都是慢病毒属，学名中“Lenti-”在拉丁文中有慢的意思。其共同特点为在其基因组的3'和5
  '有高度保守的LTR序列，其R区域用以整合酶的识别。
  [ 了解更多 ][93]

* ### 细胞检测
  
  我们的检测平台设有生物安全二级实验室，致力于提供高标准、高质量的生物质检服务。实验室严格遵循国家认
  证认可监督管理委员会（CMA）、中国合格评定国家认可委员会（CNAS）和良好生产规范（GMP）等质量体系，确
  保检测结果的准确性和可靠性。
  [ 了解更多 ][95]
* ### 外泌体检测
  
  外泌体是指包含了复杂 RNA 和蛋白质的小膜泡
  (30-150nm)，现今，其特指直径在40-100nm的盘状囊泡。1983年，外泌体首次于绵羊网织红细胞中被发现，
  1987年Johnstone将其命名为“exosome”。多种细胞在正常及病理状态下均可分泌外泌体。其主要来源于细胞内溶
  酶体微粒内陷形成的多囊泡体，经多囊泡体外膜与细胞膜融合后释放到胞外基质中 。

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

[ Explore Our Services ][68]

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

[ Request A Consult ][69]

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

#### Process Development

Process development and optimization expertise for enhanced robustness and reliable scale-up.

costs.

#### Platform Expertise

Cutting-edge cell platforms for lentiviral vector-, immune cell- and iPSC-based therapies.

Resilient manufacturing for consistent quality, certified compliance, and minimal risks at every
stage.

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

### ^{Latest News}

## WiCell Expands Stem Cell Catalog with New Parkinson’s Disease Collections

WiCell is proud to announce the addition of two new stem cell collections from the Michael J. Fox
Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (MJFF) and Aligning Science Across Parkinson’s (ASAP) to
its [catalog][57]: the ESCAPE LRRK2 Cell Line Collection, and the Isogenic Stem Cell Collection to
Research Parkinson’s Disease (iSCORE-PD).

These disease-relevant collections will enable researchers to uncover new insights into disease
mechanisms and identify therapeutic targets for Parkinson’s disease. This collaboration also
establishes a centralized online repository, ensuring researchers can easily locate and request
Parkinson’s disease relevant iPSC lines.

 

[Read More][58]

**“Fate Therapeutics has worked with WiCell over the past decade. WiCell has characterized cell
lines for Fate, and they have delivered high quality study results as well as outstanding and
knowledgeable service and technical support.”**

Bob Valamehr, Ph.D.
*President, Research & Development, Fate Therepeutics*

# Zelle® | Send and receive money directly to and from your bank account

## Here for you, so you can be there for them^{SM}

With Zelle®, the money goes directly into your bank account. That means it's easy to get paid back
or send money to a friend. 


Pause Video playing

Send money to friends and family quickly, even if they bank somewhere different than you do.¹ The
money goes directly into their bank account, so you can focus on what really counts – being there
for the people you care about.

## Digital Payment Education

We’re here to empower you with knowledge on using Zelle® safely and avoiding common scams. Explore
resources, test your knowledge and get new tips on how to keep your money safe in a digital world.

## Tips for Safer Payments

Digital payments continue to grow across the U.S. And with issues like identity theft and other
cybercrimes on the rise, it’s important to know what you can do to help protect yourself.

[Learn More][26]

## Understanding Fraud and Scams

As a consumer or small business owner, it’s important to understand how fraud and scams are defined
because there may be differences in the protections offered by your bank or credit union.

[Learn More][27]

## Partnerships

Zelle® is proud to partner with Los Angeles Football Club as a Golden Boot Club corporate partner
and the official peer-to-peer payment provider of LAFC. Through the Zelle and LAFC partnership, fans
can enjoy an enhanced matchday experience at BMO Stadium, including exclusive benefits through LAFC
Gold, the Zelle® Grand Lobby, and in-stadium moments like “Settle up in the 70th.” Together, Zelle
and LAFC are also committed to giving back to the Los Angeles community through charitable
initiatives that support local organizations and create meaningful impact across LA each year.

# Zelle® | Send and receive money directly to and from your bank account

## Here for you, so you can be there for them^{SM}

With Zelle®, the money goes directly into your bank account. That means it's easy to get paid back
or send money to a friend. 


Pause Video playing

Send money to friends and family quickly, even if they bank somewhere different than you do.¹ The
money goes directly into their bank account, so you can focus on what really counts – being there
for the people you care about.

## Digital Payment Education

We’re here to empower you with knowledge on using Zelle® safely and avoiding common scams. Explore
resources, test your knowledge and get new tips on how to keep your money safe in a digital world.

[Learn More][25]

## Tips for Safer Payments

Digital payments continue to grow across the U.S. And with issues like identity theft and other
cybercrimes on the rise, it’s important to know what you can do to help protect yourself.

[Learn More][26]

## Understanding Fraud and Scams

As a consumer or small business owner, it’s important to understand how fraud and scams are defined
because there may be differences in the protections offered by your bank or credit union.

[Learn More][27]

## Partnerships

Zelle® is proud to partner with Los Angeles Football Club as a Golden Boot Club corporate partner
and the official peer-to-peer payment provider of LAFC. Through the Zelle and LAFC partnership, fans
can enjoy an enhanced matchday experience at BMO Stadium, including exclusive benefits through LAFC
Gold, the Zelle® Grand Lobby, and in-stadium moments like “Settle up in the 70th.” Together, Zelle
and LAFC are also committed to giving back to the Los Angeles community through charitable
initiatives that support local organizations and create meaningful impact across LA each year.

[Learn More][28]
